html:
RetinaFace (ResNet-50, MobileNet-0.25; biubug6 / facexlib): finds faces with a box and five landmarks (eyes, nose, mouth corners); the detector CodeFormer and GFPGAN use for face restoration. MIT.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: RetinaFace: Single-stage Dense Face Localisation in the Wild, CVPR 2020, 2019-05-02
  • Original code: https://github.com/xinntao/facexlib at 260620ae9399
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/deepinsight/insightface/tree/master/detection/retinaface (MXNet): The authors' MXNet release has no PyTorch weights; facexlib's PyTorch port (from biubug6/Pytorch_Retinaface) is the detector the face restorers use.
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/xinntao/facexlib/blob/260620ae93990a300f4b16448df9bb459f1caba9/README.md
  • Training data: WIDER FACE (32k images, 394k labelled faces) (WIDER FACE train with the RetinaFace five-landmark annotations; the ResNet-50 backbone starts from ImageNet classification weights)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.8 (0.0 to 1.0)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: retinaface-resnet50, retinaface-mobilenet0.25
  • Outputs: keypoints, keypoint_scores, boxes, scores; label_set: face-5
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): retinaface-resnet50 3000x4000 (1.6 GiB peak allocated, 1.8 reserved); retinaface-mobilenet0.25 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved)
  • retinaface-resnet50 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 20 s (ONNX + engine).
  • retinaface-mobilenet0.25 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 9 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 54 s (ONNX + engine).
  • retinaface-resnet50 original (fp32) 1080x1920: facexlib 0.3.0 detect_faces (use_origin_size, float32): preprocessing, network, NMS, decode
  • retinaface-resnet50 original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; facexlib 0.3.0 detect_faces (use_origin_size, float32): preprocessing, network, NMS, decode
  • retinaface-mobilenet0.25 original (fp32) 1080x1920: facexlib 0.3.0 detect_faces (use_origin_size, float32): preprocessing, network, NMS, decode
  • retinaface-mobilenet0.25 original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; facexlib 0.3.0 detect_faces (use_origin_size, float32): preprocessing, network, NMS, decode
  • retinaface-resnet50 load / first call: original 0.43 s / 0.306 s, portable 0.71 s / 0.111 s, kernels 1.55 s / 0.104 s
  • retinaface-mobilenet0.25 load / first call: original 0.13 s / 1.369 s, portable 0.71 s / 0.677 s, kernels 1.49 s / 0.064 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.016 and p99 <= 0.04 (absolute error of the output keypoints).

Limitations

  • module() exports the raw per-level head maps; anchor decoding and NMS remain outside the exported graph.
  • No per-landmark confidence: keypoint_scores repeats the face score.
  • The image is not resized: large photos cost time and memory in proportion to their pixels; downscale them first for big faces.
